description: This file contains utility functions to generate URL search parameters for forwarding form responses and routing, including handling rerouting and test preview scenarios. It imports constants and helper functions related to routing forms.

methods.name: getUrlSearchParamsToForward
methods.description: Generates URL search parameters for forwarding form response data, current URL params, and additional routing info, with support for attribute routing config and CRM data.

methods.name: getUrlSearchParamsToForwardForReroute
methods.description: Prepares URL search parameters for rerouting a form response, including setting reschedule UID and rerouting flag.

methods.name: getUrlSearchParamsToForwardForTestPreview
methods.description: Creates URL search parameters for test preview links, indicating it's a test preview and excluding existing form response data.
